#!/bin/bash
set -e

export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2

cd /root/autodl-tmp/baselines/dreeam

SAVE_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/baselines/dreeam/checkpoints/teacher_roberta

echo "=== Phase A: Training DREEAM Teacher (RoBERTa-large, fully-supervised) ==="
echo "Start time: $(date)"

python run.py --do_train \
    --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_teacher_roberta \
    --train_file train_annotated.json \
    --dev_file dev.json \
    --save_path ${SAVE_DIR} \
    --train_batch_size 4 \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --gradient_accumulation_steps 1 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --lr_transformer 3e-5 \
    --max_grad_norm 1.0 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --evi_lambda 0.05 \
    --warmup_ratio 0.06 \
    --num_train_epochs 30.0 \
    --seed 66 \
    --num_class 97

echo "=== Teacher training complete at $(date) ==="

# Find the timestamped checkpoint directory
CKPT_DIR=$(ls -td ${SAVE_DIR}/*/ | head -1)
echo "Checkpoint saved at: ${CKPT_DIR}"

# Run eval on dev set (single mode)
echo "=== Running dev evaluation (single mode) ==="
python run.py --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_teacher_eval \
    --load_path ${CKPT_DIR} \
    --eval_mode single \
    --test_file dev.json \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --num_class 97

# Run eval on dev set (fusion mode)
echo "=== Running dev evaluation (fusion mode) ==="
python run.py --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_teacher_eval_fused \
    --load_path ${CKPT_DIR} \
    --eval_mode fushion \
    --test_file dev.json \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --num_class 97

echo "=== All evaluations complete at $(date) ==="
echo "Results saved in: ${CKPT_DIR}"
ls -la ${CKPT_DIR}
SCRIPT
